Each stage is one markdown prompt in `prompts/` + one JSON Schema in
`schemas/`. The orchestrator passes the schema into the system prompt so
every output is shape-stable on the first try.
system_prompt_style.note: Per-stage markdown prompt with schema injected.

planning_granularity.note: Hunt tasks stored in SQLite (runs, tasks, findings).

multi_agent_topology.note: 8 specialised stage agents in sequence, with parallel narrow Hunt agents.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Many narrow agents, deliberate disagreement, and an explicit reachability gate.
delegation_mechanism.note: Orchestrator spawns one claude subprocess per task.

human_in_loop.note: Fully non-interactive CLI run; no approval step documented.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: state.py SQLite DAO (runs, tasks, findings, traces, dedupe, costs)

long_term_memory.note: State is per-run; no cross-run memory documented.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: state.py SQLite DAO (runs, tasks, findings, traces, dedupe, costs)
state_persistence.note: Per-run-id SQLite state; resume path not explicitly documented.

self_verification.evidence_quote: Adversarial re-read; tries to **disprove** (different model from Hunt)
self_verification.note: Hunt compiles/runs PoCs; Validate is a separate-model judge (llm_judge-like).

retry_policy.evidence_quote: The runner's schema-validation + repair turn still applies
retry_policy.note: Only a single schema-repair turn, not task-level retries.

rollback.evidence_quote: work/ per-Hunt-task scratch dirs (sandbox for PoC compile/run)
rollback.note: Agent audits, does not edit target; no revert mechanism documented.

termination_condition.note: Pipeline also ends when the 8 stages complete.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: The budget guard fires between *and* within stages
cost_controls.note: Per-stage model choice exists in stages.yaml (Opus vs Sonnet) — cost-motivated routing.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote:
Hunt agents have Bash and run inside per-task scratch dirs. They are **not**
sandboxed at the OS level.
execution_isolation.note: README advises running inside a disposable VM or container.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote:
The agent reads everything you `--add-dir`, including any `.env` or
`secrets/` directories in the target.

network_policy.evidence_quote:
Network egress is restricted to that host + `127.0.0.1`. No other external
hosts.
network_policy.note: Restriction only when --target-url is set, and it is a prompt rule, not enforced; default open.

permission_model.evidence_quote: config/ stages.yaml — model + concurrency + tool allowlist per stage

tracing.evidence_quote: results/ JSONL artifacts per stage + final report.json

eval_hooks.note: Only a unit-test fixture app; no benchmark evaluation runner.
